title: Privacy by default (EU, Germany)
description: Build rules so that a visitor's browser talks only to the site's own origin until the visitor decides otherwise; consent only when needed; forms, logs, processors, AI Act labelling, and the honest wording rule. Not legal advice; status 2026-10-30; uncertain items marked.

sources.title: BGH referral VI ZR 258/24 to CJEU (TCI)
Maintainer's research notes: Was Art. 50 für Marketing heißt

items.name: No third-party request on load
items.rule: First load requests only the site's own origin (plus data:/blob:).
items.basis: Art. 6 GDPR; LG München I 3 O 17493/20
items.uncertainty: whether a dynamic IP is personal data for the operator is pending at the CJEU (VI ZR 258/24)

items.name: Self-hosted fonts
items.rule: woff2 from the site; no Google Fonts, Adobe kit, or font mirror at runtime.

items.name: No runtime CDN for scripts and styles
items.rule: Bundle or copy libraries, icons and CSS; never cdnjs, jsDelivr, unpkg at runtime.

items.name: Two-click video facade
items.rule: Local poster, provider name, one-sentence notice, iframe inserted only after click; youtube-nocookie alone is not enough. Prefer self-hosted video.

items.name: Maps without tile requests
items.rule: Static local map image with attribution plus address text and an outbound link; interactive map only behind two-click or with self-hosted tiles.

items.name: No social widgets
items.rule: Plain profile links; feeds, like and share buttons only behind two-click.

items.name: Captcha without third party
items.rule: Honeypot + minimum fill time + rate limit; ALTCHA self-hosted if needed; Friendly Captcha as processor with DPA; reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha only with consent.

items.name: No banner when nothing needs consent
items.rule: If nothing is stored on the device and nothing foreign loads, ship no cookie banner.

items.name: Proper consent when needed
items.rule: Equal accept and reject on the first layer, nothing before consent, easy withdrawal link in footer, banner designed and checked at 390 px.

items.name: Cookie-free first-party analytics
items.rule: Only if wanted: self-hosted or EU tool from own origin, no device storage, no cross-day recognition, IPs not stored, no third-party sharing; named in the policy with opt-out.
items.uncertainty: authority views differ when IPs are processed transiently; DSK OH Telemedien 2021 p. 8

items.name: Form data minimisation
items.rule: Only fields needed to answer; no consent checkbox for a simple enquiry; policy link next to submit; newsletter needs separate opt-in and double opt-in.

items.name: Form retention and uploads
items.rule: Set and implement deletion periods for stored enquiries; uploads size- and type-checked, EXIF location stripped.

items.name: Special categories only with explicit need
items.rule: Health, religion, union data only with explicit consent and need (e.g. allergy fields are health data).

items.name: Short server log retention
items.rule: Keep access logs with IPs short (common practice 7 to 14 days), state the period in the policy, configure the host to match.

items.name: Processors list with DPAs
items.rule: Every processor listed with provider, country, data, purpose, DPA date, transfer basis; every one named in the privacy policy.

items.name: Legal pages linked everywhere
items.rule: Impressum (§ 5 DDG) and privacy policy linked from every page footer; no EU ODR platform link (shut down 20.07.2025).

items.name: Accessibility statement when BFSG applies
items.rule: B2C sites with contract conclusion (shop, booking) publish § 14 BFSG information; micro-enterprises providing services are exempt; presentation sites are not covered.

items.name: AI chatbot notice
items.rule: Visible notice before the first message that the user talks to an AI.

items.name: Label photorealistic AI images
items.rule: Photorealistic AI-generated or AI-manipulated images/video/audio that could pass as real get a visible label near them; avoid them as proof of real work.
items.basis: Art. 50 (4) AI Act; Commission guidelines July 2026
items.uncertainty: generative fill/expansion is a borderline case

items.name: No blanket AI banner
items.rule: Label only the cases Art. 50 covers; service and product texts with human review need no label; public-interest news gets author and editor.

items.name: Keep provenance on AI images
items.rule: Do not strip C2PA/IPTC provenance on purpose from AI images; the default optimiser strips metadata, so keep a linked original or rely on the visible label. Strip EXIF location from real photos.

items.name: Honest wording: what was checked, never guaranteed
items.rule: Say 'built privacy-by-default, checked on <date> for X, Y, Z (report)'; never 'DSGVO-konform garantiert', '100 % rechtssicher', 'abmahnsicher', 'DSGVO-zertifiziert'.
items.why: § 5 UWG misleading claim; advertising self-evident legal duties as an advantage; competitors can enforce GDPR via UWG (CJEU C-21/23); guarantee can become a contractual warranty.

items.name: Same wording rule for accessibility
items.rule: 'Built to WCAG 2.2 AA, checked with axe-core and keyboard on <date>' yes; 'barrierefrei zertifiziert' or 'BFSG-konform garantiert' no.

items.name: Do not design around PIMS yet
items.rule: The EinwVO (in force 2025-04-01) foresees recognised consent services; none was in common use as of the last check. Keep the build consent-free instead.
